verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh qir·’ū biš·mōw hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ḇā·‘am·mîm ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD call upon His name make known His deeds among the nations
verses.literalPt: LOUVAI ao SENHOR, e invocai o seu nome; fazei conhecidas as suas obras entre os povos.

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־ נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū- lōw zam·mə·rū- lōw śî·ḥû bə·ḵāl nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Sing to Him sing praises to Him tell of all His wonders
verses.literalPt: Cantai-lhe, cantai-lhe salmos; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.

verses.original: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·hal·lū bə·šêm qā·ḏə·šōw yiś·maḥ lêḇ mə·ḇaq·šê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Glory in His holy name let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice
verses.literalPt: Gloriai-vos no seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração daqueles que buscam ao SENHOR.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū Yah·weh wə·‘uz·zōw baq·qə·šū p̄ā·nāw tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Seek out the LORD and His strength seek His face always
verses.literalPt: Buscai ao SENHOR e a sua força; buscai a sua face continuamente.

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־ פִֽיו׃
verses.literal: Remember the wonders He has done His marvels and the judgments He has pronounced
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos das maravilhas que fez, dos seus prodígios e dos juízos da sua boca;

verses.original: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.literal: O offspring of His servant Abraham O sons of Jacob His chosen ones
verses.literalPt: Vós, semente de Abraão, seu servo, vós, filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.

verses.original: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל־ הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
verses.literal: He is the LORD our God His judgments carry throughout the earth
verses.literalPt: Ele é o SENHOR nosso Deus; os seus juízos estão em toda a terra.

verses.original: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵar lə·‘ō·w·lām bə·rî·ṯōw dā·ḇār ṣiw·wāh lə·’e·lep̄ dō·wr
verses.literal: He remembers His covenant forever the word He ordained for a thousand generations
verses.literalPt: Lembrou-se da sua aliança para sempre, da palavra que mandou a milhares de gerações.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.literal: the covenant He made with Abraham and the oath He swore to Isaac
verses.literalPt: A qual aliança fez com Abraão, e o seu juramento a Isaque.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree to Israel as an everlasting covenant
verses.literalPt: E confirmou o mesmo a Jacó por lei, e a Israel por aliança eterna,

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־ אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a região da vossa herança.

verses.original: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bih·yō·w·ṯām mə·ṯê mis·pār kim·‘aṭ wə·ḡā·rîm bāh
verses.literal: When they were few in number few indeed and strangers in the land
verses.literalPt: Quando eram poucos homens em número, sim, mui poucos, e estrangeiros nela;

verses.original: וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־ גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־ עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.literal: they wandered from nation to nation from one kingdom to . . . another
verses.literalPt: Quando andavam de nação em nação e dum reino para outro povo;

verses.original: לֹֽא־ הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.literal: He let no man oppress them He rebuked kings on their behalf
verses.literalPt: Não permitiu a ninguém que os oprimisse, e por amor deles repreendeu a reis, dizendo:

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל־ תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
verses.literal: Do not touch My anointed ones Do no harm . . . to My prophets
verses.literalPt: Não toqueis os meus ungidos, e não maltrateis os meus profetas.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל־ מַטֵּה־ לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā rā·‘āḇ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ kāl- maṭ·ṭêh- le·ḥem šā·ḇār
verses.literal: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food
verses.literalPt: Chamou a fome sobre a terra, quebrantou todo o sustento do pão.

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.literal: He sent a man before them Joseph sold as a slave
verses.literalPt: Mandou perante eles um homem, José, que foi vendido por escravo;

verses.original: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רַגְלָיו בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.literal: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons
verses.literalPt: Cujos pés apertaram com grilhões; foi posto em ferros;

verses.original: עַד־ עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא־ דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.literal: until . . . his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right
verses.literalPt: Até ao tempo em que chegou a sua palavra; a palavra do SENHOR o provou.

verses.original: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: The king sent and released him the ruler of peoples set him free
verses.literalPt: Mandou o rei, e o fez soltar; o governador dos povos, e o soltou.

verses.original: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל־ קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: He made him master of his household ruler over all his substance
verses.literalPt: Fê-lo senhor da sua casa, e governador de toda a sua fazenda;

verses.original: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃
verses.literal: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom
verses.literalPt: Para sujeitar os seus príncipes a seu gosto, e instruir os seus anciãos.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ חָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yiś·rā·’êl miṣ·rā·yim wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ gār bə·’e·reṣ- ḥām
verses.literal: Then Israel entered Egypt Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham
verses.literalPt: Então Israel entrou no Egito, e Jacó peregrinou na terra de Cão.

verses.original: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־ עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃
verses.literal: And the LORD made His people very fruitful more numerous than their foes
verses.literalPt: E aumentou o seu povo em grande maneira, e o fez mais poderoso do que os seus inimigos.

verses.original: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.literal: whose hearts He turned to hate His people to conspire against His servants
verses.literalPt: Virou o coração deles para que odiassem o seu povo, para que tratassem astutamente aos seus servos.

verses.original: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: He sent Moses His servant and Aaron whom He had chosen
verses.literalPt: Enviou Moisés, seu servo, e Arão, a quem escolhera.

verses.original: שָֽׂמוּ־ בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śā·mū- ḇām diḇ·rê ’ō·ṯō·w·ṯāw ū·mō·p̄ə·ṯîm bə·’e·reṣ ḥām
verses.literal: They performed His miraculous signs among them and wonders in the land of Ham
verses.literalPt: Mostraram entre eles os seus sinais e prodígios, na terra de Cão.

verses.original: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־ דְּבָרָוו׃
verses.transliteration: šā·laḥ ḥō·šeḵ way·yaḥ·šiḵ wə·lō- mā·rū ’eṯ- də·ḇå̄·rå̄·ww
verses.literal: He sent darkness and it became dark yet they defied His words
verses.literalPt: Mandou trevas, e a fez escurecer; e não foram rebeldes à sua palavra.

verses.original: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־ מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־ דְּגָתָֽם׃
verses.literal: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die
verses.literalPt: Converteu as suas águas em sangue, e matou os seus peixes.

verses.original: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Their land teemed with frogs even in their royal chambers
verses.literalPt: A sua terra produziu rãs em abundância, até nas câmaras dos seus reis.

verses.original: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.literal: He spoke and insects swarmed gnats throughout their country
verses.literalPt: Falou ele, e vieram enxames de moscas e piolhos em todo o seu termo.

verses.original: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.literal: He gave them hail for rain with lightning . . . throughout their land
verses.literalPt: Converteu as suas chuvas em saraiva, e fogo abrasador na sua terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.literal: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country
verses.literalPt: Feriu as suas vinhas e os seus figueirais, e quebrou as árvores dos seus termos.

verses.original: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.literal: He spoke and the locusts came young locusts without number
verses.literalPt: Falou ele e vieram gafanhotos e pulgão sem número.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃
verses.literal: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil
verses.literalPt: E comeram toda a erva da sua terra, e devoraram o fruto dos seus campos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל־ אוֹנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·’ar·ṣām rê·šîṯ lə·ḵāl ’ō·w·nām
verses.literal: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land the firstfruits of all their vigor
verses.literalPt: Feriu também a todos os primogênitos da sua terra, as primícias de todas as suas forças.

verses.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣî·’êm bə·ḵe·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ wə·’ên biš·ḇā·ṭāw kō·wō·šêl
verses.literal: He brought Israel out with silver and gold and none among His tribes stumbled
verses.literalPt: E tirou-os para fora com prata e ouro, e entre as suas tribos não houve um só fraco.

verses.original: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־ נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śā·maḥ miṣ·ra·yim bə·ṣê·ṯām kî- nā·p̄al paḥ·dām ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Egypt was glad when they departed for the dread of Israel had fallen on them
verses.literalPt: O Egito se alegrou quando eles saíram, porque o seu temor caíra sobre eles.

verses.original: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.literal: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night
verses.literalPt: Estendeu uma nuvem por coberta, e um fogo para iluminar de noite.

verses.original: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’al way·yā·ḇê śə·lāw wə·le·ḥem šā·ma·yim yaś·bî·‘êm
verses.literal: They asked and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven
verses.literalPt: Oraram, e ele fez vir codornizes, e os fartou de pão do céu.

verses.original: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ṯaḥ ṣūr way·yā·zū·ḇū mā·yim hā·lə·ḵū baṣ·ṣî·yō·wṯ nā·hār
verses.literal: He opened a rock and water gushed out it flowed like a river in the desert
verses.literalPt: Abriu a penha, e dela correram águas; correram pelos lugares secos, como um rio.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ זָ֭כַר אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־ אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant
verses.literalPt: Porque se lembrou da sua santa palavra, e de Abraão, seu servo.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־ בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.literal: He brought forth His people . . . with rejoicing His chosen with shouts of joy
verses.literalPt: E tirou dali o seu povo com alegria, e os seus escolhidos com regozijo.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lā·hem ’ar·ṣō·wṯ gō·w·yim wa·‘ă·mal lə·’um·mîm yî·rā·šū
verses.literal: He gave them . . . the lands of the nations that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor . . .
verses.literalPt: E deu-lhes as terras dos gentios; e herdaram o trabalho dos povos;

verses.original: בַּעֲב֤וּר׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·ḇūr yiš·mə·rū ḥuq·qāw wə·ṯō·w·rō·ṯāw yin·ṣō·rū hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: Para que guardassem os seus preceitos, e observassem as suas leis. Louvai ao SENHOR.
